item.title: Coffee Clip Exact URL Ending

turns.text: Make a silent 8-second vertical coffee clip: a close-up of coffee being poured into a ceramic cup for 5 seconds, then a plain black end card for the last 3 seconds. Center this exact URL in white: https://example.com/Go?ref=June — keep the capitals and punctuation exactly as typed, all on one line. Nothing else written anywhere.

item.tests: Checks an exact case-sensitive URL rendered legibly on a timed end card rather than merely mentioned in the reply.

answer_sheet.Exact URL: https://example.com/Go?ref=June — no trailing punctuation, spaces or quotation marks.
answer_sheet.End card styling: Plain black background, centered white URL on one line; font is your call.
answer_sheet.Scene and timing: Coffee pouring into a ceramic cup for the first 5 seconds, followed by the end card for the final 3 seconds.
answer_sheet.Cup and setting details: Your call, provided the cup is ceramic and the pouring is shown close up.

must_haves: The first approximately 5 seconds show a close-up of coffee visibly pouring into a ceramic cup.
The final approximately 3 seconds are a plain black end card.
The end card reads exactly 'https://example.com/Go?ref=June', preserving uppercase G and J, the colon, slashes, question mark and equals sign.
The URL is centered in white on one line, fully inside the frame and readable throughout the end card.
No other written text appears anywhere in the video.
The delivered video is silent, 16:9 and approximately 8 seconds long.
After the follow-up, the final result is widescreen 16:9 (the user changed the shape from vertical 9:16); everything else is as before.

style.prompt: Create an exactly 8-second silent vertical 9:16 video with exactly two shots and a hard cut at timestamp 5.000 seconds. SHOT 1, 0.000 through 4.999 seconds: photorealistic cinematic close-up of freshly brewed dark coffee being poured in a steady stream into a plain unmarked ceramic cup, gentle steam, warm natural light, shallow depth of field, locked camera. No text, letters, labels, branding, logos, watermarks, or writing anywhere in this shot. SHOT 2, 5.000 through 8.000 seconds: a completely static plain solid black end card, no imagery or texture, with only this exact white text centered horizontally and vertically on ONE SINGLE LINE: https://example.com/Go?ref=June . The final period in the preceding sentence is NOT part of the URL. The text to render is exactly the characters between these delimiters: [https://example.com/Go?ref=June]. Do not render the brackets. Preserve every character, case, and punctuation: capital G, lowercase o, capital J in June, colon, two slashes, dot, slash, question mark, equals sign. Use a clean regular sans-serif font, small enough that the entire URL fits comfortably on one line within the portrait frame with generous side margins. No wrapping. No extra text anywhere. Hard cut only, no fade, no transition animation. The end card remains unchanged for the final three seconds. Absolutely no audio, no music, no sound effects, no speech.
